[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`dsh-draw` gives the harness one unified `image_generate` tool with standard parameters (`prompt`/`s"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ize`/`count`/`quality`/`style`/`engine`) that are translated per engine:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Multi-engine routing** — a config-driven chain (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, or any OpenAI-comp"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"atible endpoint) walked top-down with **health-aware fallback**: consecutive failures push an engine"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" into cooldown, and the next healthy engine serves the call.
- **Durable results** — generated image"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"s are saved as workspace attachments (content-addressed, under the harness's attachment policy) and "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"returned as canonical file references.
- **Quota accounting** — per-session caps on generation calls"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" and image bytes, folded from the durable session log and enforced before engine spend and before st"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"orage.
- **Credentials as references** — engine API keys are environment-variable names resolved per"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" call through the official `ctx.credentials` seam; literal keys are never stored in configuration an"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"d never logged.
- **Web surfaces** — an in-conversation result card (images, engine, quota, one-clic"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"k regenerate) and a Plugins settings tab (engine chain, credential status, probes, quota limits)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Credential references, never literals.** `apiKeyRef` names an environment variable; a `baseUrl` "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"embedding credentials fails the load loudly.
- **Sanitized display.** URLs, probe notes, and error t"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ext are redacted (userinfo passwords, credential query values, bearer tokens, JWTs) before any displ"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ay or log.
- **Quota before spend.** Generation and byte caps are checked before engine calls and be"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"fore attachment storage; exhausted sessions fail fast without spending engine credits.
- **Fail loud"},{"id":"p24s6","text":", fall back deliberately.** Malformed responses surface as structured errors; a failing engine is sk"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ipped after its cooldown threshold, and a fully exhausted chain returns the complete attempt record "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"instead of pretending success."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Image models only.** No video, audio, or edit endpoints; no vision understanding.
- **Engine com"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"patibility.** Three vocabularies are supported through the provider seam: `openai` (the `POST /image"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s/generations` shape), `replicate` (prediction create + poll), and `fal` (the `fal.run` queue). Prov"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ider-specific extras beyond `prompt`/size/count (e.g. seed, scheduler) are out of scope.
- **Cost aw"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"areness is structural.** The plugin counts calls and bytes but does not know engine pricing — pair w"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ith `dsh-budget` for cost governance.
- **Quota durability on rc.6/rc.7, 0.1.2-rc.1 and 0.1.6-alpha."},{"id":"p26s7","text":"2.** On hosts whose session log cannot carry `draw/generated` (static event whitelist, no `ignorable"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"` envelope; `0.1.2-rc.1` cannot stamp the marker and fails closed on unknown event types at read; on"},{"id":"p26s9","text":" `0.1.6-alpha.2` the append's third parameter is a `SurfaceIntent` for surface types only, so a non-"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"surface event cannot be marked), quota stays exact for the live session from the in-memory fallback "},{"id":"p26s11","text":"ledger but resets on restart; durable accounting resumes on hosts with a plugin event surface. The f"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"irst refused commit warns once, so a degraded session is visible instead of silent."}],"truncated":true}
